messages.text: Delap's chance at redemption against toothless Chelsea

metadata.summary: When Liam Delap joined Chelsea in the summer of 2025, he probably had ambitions of cementing himself as an elite Premier League No 9. Perhaps even positioning himself to be the heir to Harry Kane's throne for England.
metadata.content: Liam Delap has a chance to show Chelsea what they're missing when they travel to Nottingham Forest | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Analysis Liam Delap has a chance to show Chelsea what they're missing when they travel to Nottingham Forest Liam Delap has a chance to show former club Chelsea what they are missing as Xabi Alonso's side continue to struggle in attack without Joao Pedro; watch Nottingham Forest vs Chelsea live on Sky Sports Premier League and Main Event on Friday Night Football; kick-off 8pm Callum Bishop Football Journalist Wednesday 25 November 2026 12:17, UK When Liam Delap joined Chelsea in the summer of 2025, he probably had ambitions of cementing himself as an elite Premier League No 9. Perhaps even positioning himself to be the heir to Harry Kane's throne for England. Less than a month later, Joao Pedro made the move to Stamford Bridge and suddenly, the landscape changed. He was not the first-choice striker at the club. What followed was an arduous campaign that brought three goals in 47 games and saw Delap succumb to what is now the fabled curse of the Chelsea No 9 shirt. A club-record move to Nottingham Forest in August has yet to truly revitalise his career either. But Oliver Glasner does have faith that there's a 20-goal-a-season striker hiding in the 23-year-old. metadata.content: Aaron Collins exclusive: MK Dons striker discusses electric start to 2026/27 and first senior Wales call-up | Football News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Exclusive Aaron Collins exclusive: MK Dons striker discusses electric start to 2026/27 and first senior Wales call-up Aaron Collins discusses making his senior Wales debut and his incredible start to the season; the 29-year-old has scored 17 goals in 17 games for MK Dons so far in 2026/27; watch MK Dons vs Notts County live on Sky Sports+ on Saturday; kick-off 12.30pm Dan Long Football Journalist @DanLong__ Wednesday 25 November 2026 14:24, UK Image: Aaron Collins made his Wales debut against Portugal On Friday November 6, Aaron Collins was notified by the FAW that he was on the standby list for Wales' Nations League matches against Norway and Portugal. He knew it was a step in the right direction, but his form - 17 goals and three assists in 16 games in all competitions at the time - seemed more than worthy of an official call-up. A first chance for the MK Dons striker to represent his country since an U19 friendly defeat to Germany in April 2015 was tantalisingly close, yet just out of reach. Until November 10, that was. metadata.summary: Haas have confirmed Oliver Bearman will stay at the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, after protracted contract talks resulted in a one-year extension.
metadata.content: Oliver Bearman to remain with Haas for 2027 F1 season after new contract finally agreed ahead of Qatar GP | F1 News | Sky Sports Skip to main content Oliver Bearman to remain with Haas for 2027 F1 season after new contract finally agreed ahead of Qatar GP Oliver Bearman has signed a one-year contract extension to remain with Haas for the 2027 F1 season; watch the Qatar GP on Sky Sports F1 this weekend, with qualifying at 6pm on Saturday and the race at 4pm on Sunday Thursday 26 November 2026 09:09, UK Please use Chrome browser for a more accessible video player Oliver Bearman had previously shared his frustration at the delay in confirmation of his future at Haas. Haas have confirmed Oliver Bearman will stay at the team for the 2027 Formula 1 season, after protracted contract talks resulted in a one-year extension. Despite both the British driver and American-owned team having repeatedly insisted they wanted to continue together, negotiations had dragged on for several months, leading to speculation that his links to Ferrari - who he remains tied to after coming through their academy - were a factor in the delay. The 21-year-old said ahead of last weekend's Las Vegas Grand Prix that he was "disappointed" a resolution had not been found, but the wait for confirmation was finally ended by Haas on Thursday ahead of this weekend's Qatar Grand Prix.
